data.name: Museeb
data.gender_notes: Museeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Museeb is derived from the Arabic word 'museebah' meaning 'afflicted' or 'tested'. It refers to the trials and hardships that one may face in life, which are a test of one's faith and resilience in Allah. The name Museeb carries the meaning “Hardship, affliction, trial” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Museeb usually hope their child will grow to embody hardship, affliction, trial and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A test of faith and resilience from Allah
data.etymology: Museeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hardship, affliction, trial.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Museeb total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مصيب
in_arabic.meaning: الذي يعاني من الشدة و الضيق
in_arabic.long_meaning: مصيب هو الشخص الذي يتعرض للشدة و الضيق، و هو مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ص-ي-ب' الذي يعني 'الضيق و الشدة'. ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا مُصِيبَ مِن مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ' (سورة التغابن: 11). يعتبر اسم مصيب ذا أهمية روحية و دينية في التقاليد الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الصبر و القوة في مواجهة التحديات.

in_urdu.name: مصیب
in_urdu.meaning: جو شخص مصیبت کا شکار ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مصیب کا مطلب ہے جو شخص مصیبت یا آزمائش کا شکار ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ص-ی-ب' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'مصیبت یا ضيق'۔ قرآن مجید میں اس جڑ کا ذکر ہے، جیسے کہ: 'وَمَا مُصِيبَ مِن مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ' (سورة التغابن: 11). جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں، مصیب نام روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جو صبر اور مشکلات کا سامنا کرنے کی طاقت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुसीब
in_hindi.meaning: जो व्यक्ति मुसीबत का शिकार होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुसीब नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति मुसीबत या परीक्षा का शिकार होता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ص-ی-ب' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है 'मुसीबत या संकट'। कुरआन में इस मूल का उल्लेख है, जैसे कि: 'وَمَا مُصِيبَ مِن مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ' (सूरा التغابن: 11)। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, मुसीब नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है, जो धैर्य और चुनौतियों का सामना करने की शक्ति का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: مصيب
in_pashto.meaning: هغه کسي چې په کړاو او رنځ اخته وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مصيب هغه کسي ته ويل کيږي چې په کړاو او رنځ اخته وي. دا نوم د عربي اصل 'ص-ی-ب' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د 'کړاو یا رنځ' معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې دې اصل يادونه شوې ده، لکه: 'وَمَا مُصِيبَ مِن مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ' (سورہ التغابن: 11). د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې، مصيب نوم روحاني ارزښت لري، چې د صبر او د ننګونو سره د مقابله کولو ځواک نښه ده.

in_english.name: Museeb
in_english.meaning: One who experiences hardship or affliction
in_english.long_meaning: The name Museeb refers to someone who undergoes hardship or affliction. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ص-ی-ب' (ṣ-ȳ-b), which signifies 'hardship or distress'. This root is mentioned in the Quran, such as: 'وَمَا مُصِيبَ مِن مُصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ' (Surat At-Taghabun: 11). In Islamic tradition, the name Museeb holds spiritual significance, symbolizing patience and resilience in the face of challenges. It reflects the importance of perseverance and trust in divine decree among Muslims worldwide.

historical_references.context: The name 'Museeb' was given to a man named Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn 'Abd Al-Malik Al-Ansari. He was a companion of 'Umar ibn Abd Al-'Aziz and later served as the governor of Kufa. During his rule, he was faced with a severe drought and famine, causing widespread hardships. Despite these challenges, he remained steadfast and fair in his governance, ensuring the welfare of his people. The name 'Museeb' means 'distressed' or 'afflicted', which accurately reflects the difficult circumstances he faced during his tenure.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abi Al-Dunya, Al-Akhbar Al-Tiwal, Vol. 1, p. 171 The name Museeb carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name 'Museeb' was also given to a famous Sufi scholar named 'Abd Al-Qadir Al-Jilani. He was born in the city of Tabaristan and later settled in Baghdad, where he founded a Sufi order known as the Qadiriya. The name 'Museeb' was given to him due to his intense spiritual struggles and hardships, as well as his ability to provide comfort and relief to those in distress.
